prediction_timing: before each recorded event, after documented pre-event replacements
missing_evidence_policy: inferred from recorded events, not confirmed medical or legal eligibility
untimed_absence_policy: audit only; never remove a player retrospectively from earlier features
replacement_quota_policy: shared outgoing-player slot for diagnostics; referee restrictions require review
formal_resource_policy: only whole matches marked ready_for_resource_features; same cohort for every experimental arm
